label: Lists
title: Most Popular AI Series in 2026
excerpt: AIMB editorial list of the most popular AI series in 2026, featuring The Mother's Monster, The Chronicles of Bone, Kade Voss, The Sky-Fallen Legacy, Annunaki, The Sage, and ARK-7.
imageAlt: Three AI-generated character portraits side by side: an armored bounty hunter in a wide-brimmed hat holding a rifle, a masked gunslinger aiming a revolver in front of flames, and a skeletal pirate captain in a tricorn hat and fur collar.
body: AI series are finding a real audience on YouTube. Some projects have already reached tens of millions of views, while others are building dedicated followings through recurring characters, stronger worldbuilding, and stories that keep viewers coming back. Here are seven AI series and franchises that stood out in 2026.

1. The Mother's Monster — over 90 million views. The story follows a mother who gives birth to a dragon-like creature in a remote, snow-covered village. When the villagers turn against her child, she must decide how far she is willing to go to protect it. Created by Zahid Iqbal, the original film found a large audience thanks to its emotional core and striking fantasy imagery, later expanding into a growing franchise.

2. The Chronicles of Bone — tens of millions of views. Created by Kavan the Kid, the series throws legendary figures into a brutal fantasy world shaped by war, ancient powers, and supernatural threats. Its appeal comes from a mix of stylized action, memorable character designs, and the sense that the story is building toward something much larger.

3. Kade Voss | Bounty Hunter — more than 9 million views. The series follows a lone bounty hunter moving across dangerous worlds, taking on armed targets and navigating the lawless edges of a futuristic galaxy. Created by Neon Ridge Media, it stands out for its clear central character, cinematic action, and a world that feels built for repeat adventures.

4. The Sky-Fallen Legacy — around 9 million views. The series follows Ethan, a human engineer who crash-lands on an alien world and becomes entangled in a wider conflict involving unfamiliar civilizations and shifting loyalties. What makes the project especially interesting is the audience response: viewers discuss the characters, speculate about future twists, and treat it like an ongoing sci-fi drama.

5. ANNUNAKI: The Nibiru Legacy — more than 7 million views. Produced by 630 Motion, the project explores ancient secrets, hidden histories, and the possibility that humanity's origins are connected to forces beyond Earth. Its appeal lies in the fusion of conspiracy-laced mystery, futuristic imagery, and a premise large enough to support an expanding series universe.

6. The Sage — about 7 million views. The series follows Elijah Kelly as he returns to Mill Ford after years of war, only to discover a town shaped by fear, mystery, and something far more unsettling hiding beneath the surface. Created by Mike J Mitch and Phantom X, it builds its audience through eerie atmosphere, gradual revelations, and the promise that each episode will deepen the mystery.

7. ARK-7 — more than 4 million views. The series begins with Eva escaping a dying spacecraft and landing on a dangerous planet, where each clue about what happened only opens up bigger questions. Created by Karloff AI, it combines survival stakes with mystery-driven storytelling, giving viewers reasons to stay invested beyond the initial sci-fi setup.

Editor's note: View counts are approximate and based on publicly visible figures available in November 2026. They may include cumulative views across multiple episodes, and the totals continue to change as new viewers discover the series.
